HIBP Check

Only the first 5 hex chars of the SHA-1 leave this browser.

API

This server re-implements the official Pwned Passwords range API: GET /range/:anonk returns every SHA-1 password sharing that 5-hex prefix, one SUFFIX:COUNT per line. 404 = prefix not found. 

GET /range/:anonk
my_anonk='5BAA6'
curl "https://hibp.localhost/range/${my_anonk}"
003CD215739D7C1B2218670D26F81408237:2
003D68EB55068C33ACE09247EE4C639306B:29
...
FFCDFF228BE98F296C0CA4CE1FC8815A30E:10
FFE009206E4983ACBDBB364718B9DD273CE:1

Example: JavaScript

examples/hibp-check.js

// Same API as https://api.haveibeenpwned.com
let baseUrl = 'https://hibp.localhost';

async function passToAnonK(password) {
   let sum = await crypto.subtle.digest(
      "SHA-1", new TextEncoder().encode(password)
   );
   let hex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(sum))
      .map(function (b) {
         return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
      })
      .join("")
      .toUpperCase();
   return hex;
}

async function checkAnonK(hexHash) {
   let anonk = hexHash.slice(0, 5);
   let suffix = hexHash.slice(5);
   let resp = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/range/${anonk}`);
   if (resp.status !== 200) {
      throw new Error("range API returned status " + resp.status);
   }
   let text = await resp.text();
   let lines = text.split("\n");
   for (let line of lines) {
      if (line.startsWith(suffix)) {
         let parts = line.split(":");
         return Number(parts[1]);
      }
   }
   return 0;
}

let hexHash = await passToAnonK("password");
let count = await checkAnonK(hexHash);
// count === 52372427
console.log(count);

Example: Go

examples/hibp-check.go

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// Same API as https://api.haveibeenpwned.com
const baseURL = "https://hibp.localhost"

func passToAnonK(password string) string {
	sum := sha1.Sum([]byte(password))
	return strings.ToUpper(hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]))
}

func checkAnonK(client *http.Client, hexHash string) (int, error) {
	anonk := hexHash[:5]
	suffix := hexHash[5:]
	resp, err := client.Get(baseURL + "/range/" + anonk)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("range request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("range API returned status %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, suffix) {
			count, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(line, suffix+":"))
			if err != nil {
				return 0, fmt.Errorf("malformed count: %w", err)
			}
			return count, nil
		}
	}
	return 0, nil
}

func main() {
	client := &http.Client{
		Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
		Transport: &http.Transport{
			ForceAttemptHTTP2:     true,
			TLSHandshakeTimeout:   5 * time.Second,
			ResponseHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
			IdleConnTimeout:       30 * time.Second,
		},
	}
	hexHash := passToAnonK("password")
	count, err := checkAnonK(client, hexHash)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "hibp-check: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(count)
	// prints: 52372427
}
